about_the_game:
『 The linked clues turn to one truth. 』




Connected Clue is a mystery adventure game in which a detective directly runs through the scene and solves cases.

a robbery at a bank.
They stole the treasure, which had been kept tightly there, along with the large sum of money in the bank vault, and fled.
Be a new detective with persistence and passion, Diana, and reveal what the criminals are for and the truth of the case.


- Evidence gathering

Investigate the scene of the incident or use several tools to collect evidence.

Observe clues in detail using magnifying glass, obtain fingerprints using charcoal powder, etc
Gather detailed evidence and secure relevant testimony through probing.


- Investigating the investigation

You can talk to people and get hints about events in them.
Understand what kind of person you are through the characteristics of the other person and get a clue to the case.


- Sneak

Move forward without getting caught out of those who are wary of their surroundings.
The other way is to dress up for hidden costumes throughout the village.


- Reasoning

The evidence obtained can be organized in the 'Detective Wall' inside the detective's office.
Guess the truth of the case, such as who the victim is, what kind of relationship he has with the criminal, and what the weapon is.

If all the suspects have gathered in one place and seen through the lies in their testimony, point to the culprit through a number of questions.




Will Diana be able to solve all the cases and catch the robbers who stole the treasure?
Now unleash your reasoning skills to the fullest and challenge the unsolved case!
